retrievalProfile.description: A 1970s-style album layout featuring a central photo within a warped rectangular frame, flanked by vertical palm tree borders on a flat pastel background.
triggerTerms: curved photo frame with drop shadow
retro pop group in white suits

recipe.visualDefinition: A light blue square composition featuring a central photograph of three men in white suits performing on a stage. The photo is contained within a white-bordered frame that has a distinct outward curve on the right side and a subtle drop shadow. The top of the layout features tall, stylized Art Deco-inspired lettering, while the sides are bounded by vertical rows of small, dark palm tree icons.
coreVisualRelationships: Central photo framed by a warped rectangle against a solid pastel field
Symmetrical vertical palm tree borders framing the entire composition
Large display typography centered at the top, balanced by smaller script inside the photo
High-contrast white suits against a dark stage background within the inset
coreInvariants: Warped/curved right edge of the central photo frame

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Three figures in white suits centered within a large inset photo occupying 70% of the vertical space.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central photograph with its white border and shadow.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the large top text, moves down to the central figures, and is contained by the vertical palm tree borders.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Ample light blue space at the top and bottom edges outside the photo frame.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep navy or black for typography and palm tree icons
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Bright white for the performers' suits and the photo frame border
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation background with high value contrast in the central image.

letterConstructionRules: Distinctive 'U' and 'O' shapes with flat sides
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'S' has a tight, compressed curve
The 'R' has a short, high-starting leg
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Tall, rigid Art Deco display text paired with a loose, informal diagonal script.
graphicDevices: Drop shadow on the photo frame

preserve: Tall verticality of the main text
Diagonal orientation of the script text

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the Art Deco high-waisted aesthetic
Matches the informal secondary text style

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a light blue square background with two vertical columns of small black palm tree icons on the far left and right edges. In the center, place a large rectangular photo of three men in 1970s white suits on a stage. The photo frame should have a white border and a warped, curved right edge with a soft drop shadow.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add tall, condensed Art Deco lettering in dark navy at the top center. Add a white, hand-written style script at a 15-degree upward angle in the top left corner of the inner photo area.

verificationChecks: Is the right edge of the photo frame curved?
Are there vertical palm tree borders on both sides?
Is the top text tall and condensed?
Is the background a flat light blue?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the performers

mustAchieve: Balanced use of negative space at the top

postGenerationChecks: Check that the palm trees are aligned vertically
Ensure the white suits are the brightest element in the photo
Verify the drop shadow is subtle and consistent
Confirm the top text is centered and legible
recipe.reuseFormula: Light blue field + vertical palm borders + warped photo frame + tall Deco type = 70s Variety Aesthetic
